def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # Output-boundary predication grows rapidly when tiles overhang M or N.
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    # Last-wave idle SMs expose a nonlinear loss of available throughput.
    s = s + (-np.log2(np.maximum(1.0e-6, 1.0 - f.tail_waste))) * w[1]
    # A shallow launch cannot amortize grid-dispatch startup and wave quantisation.
    s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * w[2]
    # Register spilling introduces especially expensive local-memory accesses.
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[3]
    # Spill severity is additional cache/DRAM traffic over the compulsory traffic.
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.spill_traffic_ratio) * w[4]
    # CTA/output geometry mismatch reduces partition balance and operand reuse.
    s = s + f.tile_aspect_mismatch * w[5]
    # K-boundary predication wastes tensor work in the final reduction slice.
    s = s + f.k_tail_waste * w[6]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + np.log2(f.split_k_time_ratio) * w[7]
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[8]
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[9]
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[10]
        s = s + f.coalesced_run_deficit * w[11]
        s = s + f.output_store_coalescing_deficit * w[12]
        s = s + f.raster_reuse_residual * w[13]
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[14]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(f.split_k_time_ratio) * w[15]
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[16]
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[17]
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[18]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[19]
        s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[20]
        s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * w[21]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[22]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.total_frontend_instruction_work) * w[24]
        s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[25]
    # Two-stage eligibility and multistage depth are distinct pipeline families.
    s = s + np.where(
        f.pipeline_stage_depth < 3.0,
        f.pipeline_family_constraint * (1.0 + p.alignment_deficit),
        np.abs(np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_depth) - np.log2(3.0)) * (1.0 + p.alignment_deficit)
    ) * w[23]
    if p.log_flops < 30:
        # Short launches expose fill/drain latency before steady state is amortized.
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[26]
        # Short launches receive an independent non-monotone stage-family preference.
        s = s + np.abs(np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_depth) - np.log2(3.0)) * w[27]
        s = s + np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_depth) * w[28]
    else:
        # Long reductions expose steady-state family behavior rather than only fill/drain.
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[29]
        s = s + np.abs(np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_depth) - np.log2(3.0)) * w[30]
        s = s + np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_depth) * w[31]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # Output-boundary overhang grows multiplicatively with the wasted tile work.
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    # Final-wave loss is expressed as the corresponding inverse useful-wave factor.
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.tail_waste / np.clip(1.0 - f.tail_waste, 0.01, 1.0)) * w[1]
    # Any register spill sends the inner-loop values through local memory.
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[2]
    # Fewer resident CTAs leave fewer independent blocks to hide latency.
    s = s + f.resident_block_scarcity * w[3]
    # Multistage buffering has a discrete setup cost even before its steady-state benefit.
    s = s + f.multistage_family_indicator * w[18]
    # The multistage family becomes worthwhile only when many K-loop iterations amortize that setup.
    s = s + f.multistage_family_indicator * (np.log2(1.0 + f.mainloop_iteration_count) / 60.0) * w[19]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        # Memory-bound shapes are penalized by replicated operand loads.
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[4]
        # A large raster-band footprint reduces L2 reuse of those loads.
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_cache_pressure) * w[5]
        # Parallel split-K adds global partial write/read traffic.
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[6]
        # Serial split-K adds partial accumulator traffic to the output path.
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.serial_partial_traffic_ratio) * w[7]
        # Low-intensity CTA tiles directly increase bandwidth pressure.
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[8]
        # Register allocation directly reduces memory-latency-hiding capacity.
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[14]
        # Shared-memory allocation reduces buffering and concurrent memory CTAs.
        s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[15]
    else:
        # Pipeline prologue and epilogue are exposed when compute dominates.
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[10]
        # Unfilled thread slots reduce latency hiding in the compute regime.
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[11]
        # Serial split-K boundaries reduce independent accumulation progress.
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[12]
        # Parallel split-K also adds accumulator arithmetic in this regime.
        s = s + (f.parallel_reduction_compute_fraction / 1000.0) * w[13]
        # Register pressure limits concurrent compute CTAs independently of occupancy.
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[16]
        # Shared-memory pressure limits resident buffering and compute overlap.
        s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[17]
        if p.log_min_dim < 7 or p.output_aspect_imbalance > 0.5:
            # Short or highly rectangular outputs do not amortize absolute front-end work.
            s = s + (np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) / 30000000.0) * w[9]
            s = s + (np.log2(1.0 + f.per_thread_instruction_burden) / 30.0) * w[20]
            # Thread-level work granularity directly penalizes fixed overhead per thread.
            s = s + f.thread_work_granularity_deficit * w[21]
            # Few CTA waves expose launch and dispatch overhead in this regime.
            s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * w[22]
        else:
            # On long, balanced outputs, steady-state instruction density is amortized over more work.
            s = s + (np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) / 30000000.0) * w[23]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    s = np.log2(f.cta_launch_count) * w[0]
    s = s + np.log2(f.edge_waste + 1.0) * w[1]
    s = s + f.tail_waste * w[2]
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[3]
    s = s + np.log2(f.spill_traffic_ratio + 1.0) * w[4]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[5]
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[6]
        s = s + f.raster_band_cache_pressure * w[7]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(f.instruction_density + 1.0) * w[8]
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[9]
        s = s - np.log2(np.clip(1.0 - f.register_file_pressure, 1e-6, 1.0)) * w[10]
    if p.output_work_per_sm < 10000:
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[11]
        s = s + np.log2(f.partial_reduction_working_set_bytes + 1.0) * w[12]
        s = s + np.log2(f.split_k_time_ratio) * w[13]
        s = s + np.log2(f.accumulator_tile_storage_bytes) * w[17]
        s = s - np.log2(np.clip(1.0 - f.shared_memory_pressure, 1e-6, 1.0)) * w[18]
        s = s - np.log2(np.clip(1.0 - f.resident_block_scarcity, 1e-6, 1.0)) * w[19]
        s = s - np.log2(np.clip(1.0 - f.wave_count_deficit, 1e-6, 1.0)) * w[20]
    else:
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[14]
        s = s + np.log2(f.partial_reduction_working_set_bytes + 1.0) * w[15]
        s = s + np.log2(f.split_k_time_ratio) * w[16]
        s = s + np.log2(f.accumulator_tile_storage_bytes) * w[21]
        s = s - np.log2(np.clip(1.0 - f.shared_memory_pressure, 1e-6, 1.0)) * w[22]
        s = s - np.log2(np.clip(1.0 - f.resident_block_scarcity, 1e-6, 1.0)) * w[23]
        s = s - np.log2(np.clip(1.0 - f.wave_count_deficit, 1e-6, 1.0)) * w[24]
    if p.log_flops < 40:
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[25]
        s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[26]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[27]
        s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[28]
    else:
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[29]
        s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[30]
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[31]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[32]
    if p.output_work_per_sm < 10000:
        s = s + np.log2(f.n_swizzle_locality_cost) * w[33]
    elif p.roofline_ratio < 1 and p.l2_working_set_pressure > 0.5:
        s = s + np.log2(f.n_swizzle_locality_cost) * f.raster_band_cache_pressure * np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[34]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(f.n_swizzle_locality_cost) * w[35]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    # Boundary overhang and final-wave idle time are broad, nonlinear launch losses.
    s = np.log2(1.0 + f.edge_waste) * w[0]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 / np.maximum(1.0e-6, 1.0 - f.tail_waste)) * w[1]
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[2]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.spill_traffic_ratio) * w[3]
    s = s + f.wave_count_deficit * w[4]
    s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[5]
    if p.output_aspect_imbalance > 0.5:
        s = s + f.tile_aspect_mismatch * w[6]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.cta_operand_bytes) * w[7]
        s = s + f.thread_work_granularity_deficit * w[8]
    else:
        s = s + f.tile_aspect_mismatch * w[9]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.cta_operand_bytes) * w[10]
        s = s + f.thread_work_granularity_deficit * w[11]

    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) * w[12]
        s = s + f.tile_roofline_deficit * w[13]
        s = s + f.operand_layout_stride_penalty * w[14]
        s = s + f.output_store_coalescing_deficit * w[15]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_cache_excess) * w[16]
    else:
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[17]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[18]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density) * w[19]
        s = s + f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[20]
        # Cache excess is bounded and is only priced in a pressure context.
        if p.l2_working_set_pressure < 0.5:
            s = s + (np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_cache_excess) / (1.0 + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_cache_excess))) * (0.5 * f.occupancy_deficit + 0.5 * f.register_file_pressure) * w[21]
        else:
            s = s + (np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_cache_excess) / (1.0 + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_cache_excess))) * (0.25 * f.occupancy_deficit + 0.25 * f.register_file_pressure + 0.5 * (np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio) / (1.0 + np.log2(f.operand_tile_traffic_ratio)))) * w[22]

    if p.log_flops < 30:
        if p.output_work_per_sm < 10000:
            s = s - np.log2(1.0 + f.cta_launch_count) * w[23]
        else:
            s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.cta_launch_count / np.power(2.0, p.log_flops)) * w[24]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.cta_launch_count / np.power(2.0, p.log_flops)) * w[25]

    if p.output_work_per_sm < 10000:
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[26]
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[27]
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_compute_fraction * w[28]
        s = s - np.log2(f.split_k_parallel_time_ratio) * w[29]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.split_k_wave_quantization_loss) * w[30]
    else:
        s = s + f.serial_reduction_dependency * w[31]
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_traffic_fraction * w[32]
        s = s + f.parallel_reduction_compute_fraction * w[33]
        s = s + np.log2(f.split_k_parallel_time_ratio) * w[34]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.split_k_wave_quantization_loss) * w[35]

    if p.log_min_dim < 8 or p.alignment_deficit > 0.25:
        s = s + f.stage_count_overhead_fraction * w[36]
        s = s + f.stage_count_overhead_fraction * f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[37]
        s = s + f.stage_count_overhead_fraction * f.k_tail_waste * w[38]
    else:
        s = s + f.stage_count_overhead_fraction * w[39]
        s = s + f.stage_count_overhead_fraction * f.pipeline_fill_drain_fraction * w[40]
        s = s + f.stage_count_overhead_fraction * f.k_tail_waste * w[41]
    return s
